sql: with lp as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, captured_at, side, quantity, realized_pnl from positions order by market_ticker, captured_at desc) select market_ticker, side, quantity, realized_pnl, to_char(captured_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as captured from lp where quantity <> 0 and market_ticker not like '%RT-RES%' order by captured desc limit 20
